error[L0533]: link(boot_stage) marks a naked routine, and this is an ordinary routine

14 | link(boot_stage) stage: () -> none = end stage

  = note: D587: a boot stage is `link(boot_stage) extern(naked) NAME: () -> none`, whose body is the one assembler.block the boot ROM enters
